newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa plans no stake in Manila airport.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa plans no stake in Manila airport.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG denied on Thursday it had any plans to take a direct stake in a consortium to build a new passenger terminal at the Manila international airport.
"We have no plans for a direct stake of any kind," Peter Bleuth, manager of Lufthansa airport and ground services, told Reuters in response to enquiries.

An unnamed official of the consortium, led by People's Air Cargo and Warehousing Co Inc (Paircargo), said earlier on Thursday that the German flag carrier was expected to take a 20 percent stake in the consortium.
Lufthansa and Paircargo together run the Philippine airport and ground service joint venture, which is due to participate in the project.
But Lufthansa's Bleuth said the airline's involvement would be limited to project management and related services.
